decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted   therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The retail unit shall not be open to customers outside the hours of 8am to 10pm.
Condition : 4 - No deliveries shall be taken at or despatched from the site outside the hours of 7am to 10pm Monday to Friday, 8am to 8pm Saturday and 10am to 6pm Sunday.

Condition : 5 - The noise rating level from fixed mechanical plant associated with the development shall be 5dB(A) below the existing Lae background noise levels at any time with aircraft landing in a westerly direction on the northern runway.  The measurements and assessment shall be made in accordance with BS4142:1990 method for rating industrial noise affecting mixed residential and industrial areas.
description: Alterations to the external appearance of the retail unit and surrounds, including increased disabled parking; trolley bays; new plant; louvers and scissor lift; draught screen to customer entrance, security hatch; and replacement of entrance doors.
